title: Update app title to IoT Based Smart Waste Management System

requirements.text: Update the browser tab title in frontend/index.html to 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System'. Also ensure any visible page-level headings or app name labels across the application (sidebar header, landing page hero title, login page header) consistently display 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System'.

quotes: add title as Iot based smart waste management system

acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab (document title in index.html) reads exactly 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System'.
The landing page hero section title displays 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System'.
Any sidebar or top-bar app name label displays 'IoT Based Smart Waste Management System'.
No other page titles or app name references contradict this value.

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not alter any existing feature logic, routing, or data simulation when making title changes.
nonGoals: Changing the visual design, color scheme, or layout.
